name: MiniMax H3 Image — 12GB tiled (beta)
description: MiniMax H3 Image at full 16MP with tiled decoding, for 12GB cards
notes: BETA / UNVERIFIED: full 16MP (4096x4096) H3 Image with tiled decoding enabled. Same official sampling as the vanilla preset (6 steps, TFG 1, DDIM Trailing, shift 3). The H3 VAE reference decodes in 256px tiles (disabling tiling changes output), but 256px tiles are slow; community VRAM guidance is 8GB->512, 12GB->768, 16GB+->untiled, hence 768/64 here. Kontext-style: up to 16 refs as <Picture N>, strength 1.0. Not on .150 yet and gRPC support unconfirmed. ASSETS PRESENT BUT NOT SERVED: .150 has minimax_h3_image_i4x.ckpt (24.16GB), minimax_h3_image_vae_f16.ckpt (1.09GB) and qwen3_vl_32b_50_i4x (~15.3GB), yet the gRPC list_files does not advertise the model - the server build does not support it yet. Do not force it: ~40.6GB of weights cannot fit 12GB VRAM + 24GB RAM, so an attempt risks taking the host down rather than just failing.
